functionDeclarations.name: get_business_profile
functionDeclarations.description: Get the business's own saved profile (name, type, industry, location, registration id). Use this to understand the business before answering — do not ask the user for something already in this profile.

functionDeclarations.name: get_compliance_items
functionDeclarations.description: List all compliance items on file for the business, with their current status.

functionDeclarations.name: get_expiring_compliances
functionDeclarations.description: List compliance items expiring soon or already expired.

functionDeclarations.name: get_scheme_matches
functionDeclarations.description: Get government schemes/subsidies from Venture's own verified records that may be relevant to this business based on its profile.

functionDeclarations.name: discover_current_schemes
functionDeclarations.description: Search the live web for current government schemes/subsidies beyond Venture's verified records. Use this when the user asks about "other", "additional", "latest", or "any other" schemes not already covered by get_scheme_matches. Results are unverified and must be presented as discovered via search, not as confirmed Venture records.

functionDeclarations.name: get_sustainability_profile
functionDeclarations.description: Get the deterministic baseline sustainability recommendations plus any user-provided context (electricity, transport, waste, water notes) already saved for this business. Combine this with anything the user says in the conversation to personalize suggestions — do not just repeat the baseline list verbatim if you have more specific information to work with.
